title: Resigning from Arch Linux
excerpt: This is just a short note on my blog that I have resigned from Arch Linux a package maintainer, developer and security team. I’ve spent around 10 years as an AUR maintainer, security team, Package Maintainer and then Developer. I implemented support for debug packages, did the initial POC work that would become the git migration and even somehow managed to pull of an online conference during The Plague with the help of others.
content_html:
This is just a short note on my blog that I have resigned from Arch Linux a package maintainer, developer and security team.

I’ve spent around 10 years as an AUR maintainer, security team, Package Maintainer and then Developer. I implemented support for debug packages, did the initial POC work that would become the git migration and even somehow managed to pull of an online conference during The Plague with the help of others.

For fun, here is my Package Maintainer application (formerly TU) that was sent 9 years ago to the aur-general list: https://lists.archlinux.org/archives/list/aur-general@lists.archlinux.org/thread/JQWKMMRV74EWK77YHOM4QAM2SVNV7GDZ/

Things are changing and it’s a good time to let go.

I still intend to continue working on my projects around TPMs, secure boot and platform security stuff.

The resignation email: https://lists.archlinux.org/archives/list/arch-dev-public@lists.archlinux.org/thread/2AX2BCJ3EQX7G3YXSDX73BR4NCAWXXBZ/

content_html_zh:
这只是我博客上的一个简短说明，我已经从 Arch Linux 的软件包维护者、开发人员和安全团队辞职。

我花了大约 10 年的时间担任 AUR 维护人员、安全团队、包维护人员，然后担任开发人员。 我实现了对调试包的支持，完成了最初的 POC 工作，后来成为 git 迁移，甚至在其他人的帮助下设法在瘟疫期间举办了一次在线会议。

为了好玩，这里是我的软件包维护者应用程序（以前称为 TU），它于 9 年前发送到 aur-general 列表：https://lists.archlinux.org/archives/list/aur-general@lists.archlinux.org/thread/JQWKMMRV74EWK77YHOM4QAM2SVNV7GDZ/

事情正在发生变化，现在是放手的好时机。

我仍然打算继续围绕 TPM、安全启动和平台安全内容开展我的项目。

辞职邮件：https://lists.archlinux.org/archives/list/arch-dev-public@lists.archlinux.org/thread/2AX2BCJ3EQX7G3YXSDX73BR4NCAWXXBZ/
